dedupe_keys.name: anonymized subset of smart meter data

description: Anonymized Subset of Smart Meter Data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Alka Malik, Nidhi Malik (The NorthCap University). The dataset is a modified or anonymised form of the data acquired from smart meters in an Indian city at 15-minute intervals. As a result, it corresponds correctly to the demographics and family size of the population. Coverage: national (IN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
